user_saw: An operator-created scheduled job trying to edit a Discord channel received an error requiring a trusted Discord sender identity.
summary: The fix lets Discord channel edits use a live operator job grant, checks that grant during lookups and retries, and preserves accepted edit results after cancellation.
reasoning: The pre-fix Discord handler rejected guild administration without a Discord sender or qualifying owner context, and that guard predates the shallow history boundary. I checked the scheduled-authority changes and found that #150166 carried the live job grant into message dispatch for reads, but the available history did not establish when scheduled edits first failed or whether they had previously worked.
